title: DENSE: Distilling Agent Trajectories into Evidence-Grounded Shortcut Trees for Self-Refinement
title_zh: DENSE：将智能体轨迹蒸馏为证据驱动的捷径树以实现自我改进
abstract_en: Online agent deployments produce abundant execution traces, while task-specific verification and expert annotation are costly to scale. We study how to distill these traces into reusable feedback without post-hoc outcome labels, drawing on their evidence of local progress, recovery, and unfinished requirements. We introduce DENSE (Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions), which organizes this evidence into evidence-grounded nested shortcut trees. DENSE compresses redundant attempts, reconciles issues across levels using recovery evidence, and summarizes completed branches while expanding unresolved ones, linking reusable progress to remaining obligations. We introduce REFIT, a source-paired protocol comparing feedback from shared initial trajectories under post-hoc outcome blindness, with environments and model contexts reset for fresh attempts at the same tasks. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, DENSE achieves the highest strict pass rate among tested non-privileged feedback methods across four recipient models. Relative to initial executions, strict pass rate improves by 7.12-15.64 pp, with 19.0-43.6% fewer observed recipient tokens in reruns. GPT-5.5 ablations support combining nested subtask analysis with shortcut construction and issue reconciliation. These findings point toward agent self-refinement through evidence-grounded trajectory reuse with less reliance on external supervision.
abstract_zh: 在线部署的智能体会产生大量执行轨迹，但针对特定任务的验证与专家标注难以低成本扩展。本文研究如何在不使用事后结果标签的情况下，从轨迹中的局部进展、错误恢复和未完成要求等证据中提炼可复用反馈。作者提出 DENSE（Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions），将上述证据组织为证据驱动的嵌套捷径树：压缩冗余尝试，利用恢复证据协调不同层级的问题，并对已完成分支进行总结、对未解决分支进行展开，从而关联可复用进展与剩余任务要求。论文还提出 REFIT，一种源轨迹配对评测协议：不同反馈方法共享相同的初始轨迹，同时无法获知事后任务结果，并在重置环境和模型上下文后重新尝试同一任务。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，DENSE 面向四种接收模型均取得了受测非特权反馈方法中的最高严格通过率。相比初始执行，其严格通过率提升 7.12 至 15.64 个百分点，同时重试阶段观测到的接收模型 token 数减少 19.0% 至 43.6%。基于 GPT-5.5 的消融实验表明，嵌套子任务分析、捷径构建与问题协调需要结合使用。结果显示，基于证据复用智能体轨迹，有望在减少外部监督依赖的同时实现有效的自我改进。
key_points_zh: DENSE 无需事后结果标签，而是从执行轨迹中的局部进展、恢复行为和未完成要求中提炼可复用反馈。
方法构建证据驱动的嵌套捷径树，压缩重复尝试、协调跨层级问题，并区分已完成分支与待解决义务。
REFIT 协议通过共享初始轨迹、隐藏事后结果并重置环境与模型上下文，实现更公平的反馈方法比较。
在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，DENSE 对四种接收模型均取得非特权反馈方法中的最高严格通过率，提升 7.12–15.64 个百分点。
DENSE 在提高成功率的同时减少 19.0%–43.6% 的重试 token；GPT-5.5 消融实验验证了嵌套分析、捷径构建和问题协调的互补性。

llm_assessment.comment: DENSE offers a promising trace-driven self-refinement framework that converts unlabeled executions into structured, evidence-grounded feedback for subsequent agent attempts.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: DENSE把无结果标签的执行轨迹转化为结构化且有证据支撑的反馈，为智能体后续重试提供了有前景的自改进机制。
